lesson.meaning: To appear or come into existence; to happen or emerge.
examples: A few questions might arise during the presentation, so be prepared.
If any issues arise with the new software, please report them immediately.
Unexpected problems often arise when starting a new project.
From this discussion, new ideas for our marketing strategy could arise.
A sudden opportunity to travel abroad arose last week, so I booked a ticket.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of 'arise' as something 'coming up' or 'popping up' unexpectedly, like a question or a problem.
